audit_checks.scope: Finite ordinary trees; x(T)+2<=p; 3p<2alpha(T)+1; strict selector over every original leaf; fixed F; original supports and neighborhoods; separate tags for leaves sharing a support.
audit_checks.rank_domain: p>=2 follows from x>=0 and x+2<=p; k=p-1>=1; k+1=p.
audit_checks.identity_derivation: For each fixed favorable leaf v, q_v(j)=i_j(H_v)-i_j(R_v) counts exactly the independent j-sets of H_v meeting W_v because R_v=H_v-W_v. The contract summand is Delta_k(H_v)-Delta_k(R_v)=q_v(k+1)-q_v(k). Summing over the same fixed F gives S=dim K_(k+1)-dim K_k.
audit_checks.operator_domain_and_codomain: Every retained deletion B is an independent k-set in H_v; if B still meets W_v its original tag is valid. Otherwise transferred w is selected only when B is independent in H_w and meets W_w, so the output belongs to K_k. A fixed total order makes selection single-valued.
audit_checks.injectivity_gap: No rank, matching, or kernel argument establishes injectivity. Different input columns can share output basis vectors, and signed contributions can cancel; nonzero individual columns would not suffice. Injectivity, if established, would imply dim K_(k+1)<=dim K_k and hence S<=0, but the route proves no such property. Failure of injectivity alone would not imply S>0.
audit_checks.standing_controls_and_realizability: No new tree witness, positive sum, or finite census is claimed. The definitions make the construction applicable on eligible instances; universal injectivity is unproved. The handoff's T22 local-map obstruction is not treated as a counterexample to this different cross-tag map.
audit_checks.independent_tests: Manually expanded the q-difference identity and checked basis membership for each deletion branch. No source replay, literature application, exhaustive computation, or concrete map-rank computation is used as evidence.

limitations: No universal injectivity proof or eligible counterexample to this exact operator was established.
The candidate operator does not resolve the registered aggregate without the missing injectivity or another global argument.
